text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon won the Satsuki Sho, 
splendidly capturing the center position 
for the Winning Live.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A packed stadium roaring with cheers. It 
was the longed-for view seen by top 
Uma-Idols that she had always envisioned.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next time, she wants to see that same 
scenery on a dirt track. With her goal now 
crystal clear, Smart Falcon's next choice 
was――

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Dirt Derby. She decided to 
proceed to this rare Classic-class GⅠ dirt 
race.
